title: Accounts Administrator
company: Abbey Personnel Services Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Established in 2006, My client is a trusted specialist in curtain walling, windows, doors, shopfronts, and entrances. With over 40 years of industry expertise and a reputation for quality, based in Sherburn in Elmet with excellent access to major road networks. We pride ourselves on delivering tailored solutions and efficient service to every client.

We're looking for a detail-oriented Accounts Administrator to join our team full-time, on-site in Sherburn in Elmet. You'll be the backbone of our office operations, keeping our finances accurate and our administration seamless.

What You'll Do:
- Maintain accurate financial records using Xero accounting software
- Handle office administration: correspondence, filing, scheduling, and document management
- Provide excellent customer service to clients and internal teams
- Manage office equipment, including basic troubleshooting and inventory
- Support daily operations to keep everything running smoothly

- Attention to detail and ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment

- Experience providing exceptional customer service

Why Join Us?
- Be part of an established, respected company with 20 years in the industry
- Supportive team environment with opportunities to grow
- Accessible location near Leeds with excellent transport links

title: Accounts Receivable Controller
description:
Accounts Receivable Controller
Nigel Wright are currently supporting a North Yorkshire based organisation with their temporary Accounts Receivable Controller requirement. This will be an initial 3 month assignment with hybrid working offered.

The Role
As Accounts Receivable Controller, you will:
- Manage the credit control process across a high-volume ledger
- Monitor aged debt and deliver against collection targets and KPIs
- Allocate payments and remittances accurately
- Reconcile debtor and control accounts
- Ensure invoices and credit notes are accurate, authorised and issued on time
- Maintain reliable records of rates, contract terms and billing arrangements
- Investigate billing discrepancies, unbilled income and changes affecting charges
- Resolve queries while maintaining positive customer relationships
- Strengthen policies and procedures covering income, sales ledger and aged debt
- Support revenue reporting and cash-flow forecasting

The Candidate
You will bring significant credit control experience, ideally gained in a comparable high-volume environment. You will have a strong understanding of sales ledger processes and the proven ability to reduce debt without compromising customer service.
Strong Excel skills, attention to detail and the ability to remain organised under pressure are essential. You will be proactive, comfortable working to deadlines and targets, and able to use your initiative while contributing effectively as part of a team.
Applications
Interested? Apply now!

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Consortium Professional Recruitment are working with an established organisation in Pocklington to find a Finance Assistant who enjoys being involved, taking responsibility and making sure things happen when they should. You'll be joining a team where your contribution will be valued, with the opportunity to work across several areas of finance rather than being limited to one particular task.

The Opportunity:
As a Finance Assistant, you'll be involved in the financial activities that help keep a busy organisation running effectively.

You'll have the opportunity to:
- Process accurate monthly payroll, including PAYE, workplace pensions, P60s and P11 Ds.
- Maintain purchase and sales ledgers, process invoices, expenses and supplier payments, and assist with credit control.
- Complete bank and credit card reconciliations, administer petty cash and maintain fixed asset records.
- Support month-end and year-end activities, VAT returns and annual accounts preparation.
- Your work will directly contribute to a well-organised finance function, supporting informed decisions and helping the wider organisation operate with confidence.

About You:
You might already be working in an accounts team, supporting payroll or handling a mixture of finance responsibilities. What's important is that you're comfortable with numbers, enjoy finding solutions and can be relied upon to follow things through.

We're particularly interested in hearing from people who bring:
- Practical experience in finance or payroll, with an understanding of how accurate financial information supports a business.
- The confidence to work with spreadsheets, financial systems and detailed information.
- A methodical approach, with the ability to spot when something doesn't look quite right.
- The initiative to manage your own workload while knowing when to ask questions or involve others.
- A friendly, professional manner and the ability to build positive working relationships.
- Knowledge of Sage or Xero would be useful.

If you're studying towards AAT that's an added bonus.

The Benefits and Package:
In return, you'll enjoy:
- £29,000 to £32,000 depending on experience.
- Life insurance, healthcare scheme, company pension and 25 holidays + bank holidays
- A broad role offering exposure to payroll, financial accounting, reporting and audit processes.
- Opportunity to develop your career and complete further qualifications.
- Collaborative team working alongside an experienced and supportive Finance Manager

How to Apply:
If you're a Finance Assistant looking for a role with greater variety, or you're currently working in accounts or payroll and ready for your next move, we'd be pleased to hear from you!

This exciting Finance Assistant / Payroll Administrator opportunity is being managed by Consortium Professional Recruitment, a trusted recruitment partner with a Human First approach.

If you're ready to take the next step in your finance career, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with your CV attached.

Consortium Professional Recruitment Ltd are a professional level recruitment consultancy specialising in the delivery of high relevance recruitment services on behalf of our clients across the UK. We regularly receive large responses to our advertising which can make providing individual feedback to every applicant challenging. If you haven't received a reply from us within 14 days of your application, we regret to say your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion. We have a policy of retaining your details for future vacancies unless you request otherwise. To learn more about our services, please visit consortiumrecruitment.co.uk

title: Finance Assistant
description:
As a Finance Assistant, you will support the day-to-day finance function, assisting with transactional finance duties, reconciliations, month-end processes and finance administration.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established and growing organisation operating within the renewable energy sector,

Description
- Process purchase invoices, payments and employee expenses.
- Maintain purchase and sales ledgers.
- Reconcile bank accounts and supplier statements.
- Support credit control activities and chase outstanding debt.

- Maintain accurate financial records and documentation.
- Respond to internal and external finance queries.
- Process and update information within Xero and other finance systems.
- Support finance process improvement initiatives.
- Assist with transactional finance work arising from business acquisitions.

Profile

A successful 'Finance Assistant' should have:
- Previous experience in a Finance Assistant, Accounts Assistant or Assistant Accountant position.
- Strong purchase ledger and sales ledger experience.
- Experience completing bank and supplier reconciliations.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- Experience using finance software, ideally Xero.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- The ability to work independently and manage a busy workload.
- Excellent communication skills.
- A proactive approach and willingness to support the wider team.
- Immediate availability or a short notice period.

Job Offer
- Temporary Finance Assistant opportunity.
- Hourly rate of £15 - £17 per hour.
- Hybrid working arrangement.
- Free Parking.
- Immediate start available.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Ledger Clerk
company: Optimum Recruitment Group Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:

You will be responsible for the supporting of processing sales orders, and to ensure the smooth flow of customers orders through the system, as well as maintaining various other office records and data bases as required.

This role would suit an experienced administrator who is happy to come in and get stuck into whatever requires doing within this small team.

Your key responsibilities will include:

Undertaking certain sales administration duties as directed weekly, e.g. checking of sales orders.

Full holiday cover for sales administration team, including processing orders, speaking to customers, invoicing, printing delivery notes, filing.

Numerate and literate, including good GCSEs or equivalent.

Computer literate, including MS Office and Accounting system skills.

Polite and courteous.

Excellent attention to detail.

Good communication and telephone skills.

Benefits:
- Company pension
- Free parking
- Life insurance
- On-site parking

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
An independent accountancy firm in Harrogate is looking to recruit a Payroll Administrator to join its team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with some payroll experience who is looking to develop their payroll experience. Applicants from both industry and practice backgrounds will be considered, with full training and ongoing support provided.

Responsibilities will include:
- Processing weekly, fortnightly and monthly payrolls for a portfolio of clients.
- Calculating statutory payments, including SSP, SMP and SPP.
- Processing starters, leavers and payroll amendments.
- Preparing and submitting RTI returns to HMRC.
- Assisting with pension submissions and auto-enrolment.
- Responding to client payroll queries.

The successful candidate will have:
- Payroll experience, gained in either industry or practice.
- Good attention to detail and organisational skills.
- A willingness to learn and develop their payroll knowledge.
- A friendly, approachable manner and good communication skills.
